Inspect a week

Where work accumulates

Inside the learning model

Each present person has one week of time. Output = time × skill. The strongest eligible person/skill pair works first; remaining time may serve another queue. Knowledge earned through work arrives at week end: 0.015 × time × remaining room to learn.

Each coaching period reserves its requested fraction from both people. If simultaneous requests exceed a person’s week, every involved period is scaled by its more constrained participant. Spare time remains available for work. A period with an absent participant or the same mentor and learner is blocked without using time.

Coaching gain = 0.65 × actual fraction × the positive skill gap at the start of that week. All gains arrive at week end. A learner cannot pass on knowledge gained during that same week. A mentor with no skill advantage still spends the time, but transfers no knowledge.

Fictional divisible, independent work. No forgetting, hiring, motivation, coordination cost or differences in teaching ability. “60% coverage” is an assumption, not certification. Pinned plans retain starting skills and assignments; demand and absences are always shared. Read the engine.
